The evidence indicates that the compound may act as a modulator of the EDD domain protein, DegV family, possibly through a mechanism involving the inhibition of its activity or regulation of its expression. The strength of the evidence is moderate, as the relationship is inferred through a chain of targets, and further experimental validation would be required to confirm the direct interaction between the compound and the EDD domain protein.
